summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing drilling results at the Apollo system in Colombia. The release details high-grade tungsten, gold, silver, and copper intercepts from holes APC-162 and APC160-D1, including 27.35 m at 37.55 g/t AuEq. The company has 13 rigs running and $113.3 million cash. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special-situation event; this is a routine operational update on exploration results.
